about: Hand translation of the Egg Defender vehicle scripts (assets/data/vehicles/EggDefender_N/*.scripts.lua). spawnAtGroundLevel defaults to true (EggDefenderVehicle.init: vehicleScripts.spawnAtGroundLevel ~= false); these vehicles set it to false and keep the wave's height. no_teleport: disableTeleporting = true, the vehicle stays at (wave x + slingshot x) like the first wave.
